fusions.name: Quick Report
fusions.desc: Fires a slug on a strand that deals 9 damage to the first enemy it meets. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1 second. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Dead Reckoning
fusions.desc: Lines up a strand-guided shot that deals 36 damage to one enemy within 10 tiles. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health. Deals up to 1.5 times as much at maximum range.

fusions.name: Steadied Aim
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Twitch Reflex
fusions.desc: When you are hurt, you fire back at the nearest enemy within 5 tiles for 7 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
